integrity: An exact elementary proof and standalone finite cross-checks are supplied. Published-source comparisons do not constitute global priority certification; no independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to positive four-run parameters on the binary alphabet with opposite ordered two-run operands. Distinct words, not shuffle path multiplicity, are counted. Equivalence in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Two-phase normal form and exact DFA complexity of opposite-run binary shuffles
